profile_text.body:
Alignment Research Center (ARC) is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. According to its website, ARC's mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests.

The organization describes its motivation as addressing the challenge that new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities. ARC states that as AI progress accelerates it may become increasingly difficult to adapt quickly enough to keep up with the changing technology, and that the field would be better prepared with methods that could be safely scaled over many orders of magnitude, in the same way that generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up dramatically over the last decade.
